props.title: Peer landscape — Flue + Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects

props.content: Summary: Two high-quality open-source peers were identified and verified: Cloudflare's official `cloudflare/agents` (production-grade Durable Objects + Workers SDK with ai-chat/examples) and `withastro/flue` (an agent harness with explicit Cloudflare deployment examples). Several community demos exist (workersai, agents-starter, flue demos) but are example-quality not full platforms. Source: ai-artifacts/agent-reliability-benchmark/research/16-peer-landscape.md (section Summary and Findings).

props.caption: Verified candidate evaluation (columns AV=Availability, ST=State loss, DP=Data privacy, CS=Cost/runaway, MM=Model misbehavior, CR=Concurrency, SE=Sandbox escape, OB=Observability)

props.content:
Why no single true peer exists (evidence):
- cloudflare/agents is the broadest, production-grade SDK with explicit mitigations for state-loss, concurrency, and observability (see: packages/ai-chat README; examples/playground/wrangler.jsonc).  
- withastro/flue provides an explicit Cloudflare target and end-to-end examples (examples/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc) but is a framework/harness rather than a full platform with enterprise governance.  
- Multiple community repos (ethanolivertroy/flue-grc-engineer-demo, adewale/MaintainerBot, akazwz/workersai) are end-to-end but narrow demos and not broad, maintained platforms.  
Conclusion (from research file): there is no other large independent open-source project that combines Workers + Durable Objects + AI bindings with a full remote-agent + chat/task surface the way Cloudflare/agents does. (ai-artifacts/.../research/16-peer-landscape.md, Findings 1–7).

Next actions suggested in the research (verbatim guidance):
- Run a smoke deployment of a Flue Cloudflare example and Cloudflare agents playground to validate: scheduled tasks, Durable Object eviction/restart, stream disconnect/reconnect recovery, tool approval flows.  
- Test cost-control approaches (route model calls through AI Gateway and simulate traffic).  
- If security is critical, run a sandbox-audit exercise and consult Cloudflare engineering.  
(See research/16-peer-landscape.md, Suggested next steps).
